prompt: Storybook nocturne illustration, flat color shapes with soft gradient atmosphere and sharp silhouette edges, atmospheric indie game art style. A small craftsmen village at night. All warm light comes from bare filament bulbs in simple wire cages hung above doorways. Several vacant plots with low stone foundations and plain fences wait between the houses. In the left foreground stands an ANCIENT STONE APPARATUS: a tall weathered standing stone fitted with brass collars and a small brass dial, copper conduit running from its base into the ground, and a vertical column of faintly glowing amber marks cut into its face; moss on its northern shoulder. Dark pine trees frame one edge. Low drifting mist, a few floating sparks of light, stars, a crescent moon. STRICTLY LIMITED NIGHT PALETTE: deep indigo and slate blue night, muted moss green, charcoal; the ONLY saturated color is warm amber filament light and the glowing marks on the stone. Artisanal and handmade, NOT industrial: no factories, no smokestacks, no conveyors, no machinery. No people, no animals, no creatures, no text, no signage. Elevated three-quarter view looking down over the whole settlement so the full layout of plots and lanes is visible, about thirty small buildings and empty lots in total.
